messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The webhooks service belongs to Team Atlas as of 2025-09-09, after Ember handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service belongs to team Ember as of 2025-04-11. [decision; valid 2025-04-11 to 2025-09-09; recorded by handover/2025-04-11-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service is a Boreal service as of 2025-01-09. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- Ember handed the webhooks service to Team Atlas on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-webhooks]
- Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Priya for the webhooks service handover on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-webhooks]
- The webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout. [valid 2025-04-22 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-04-22-2]
- The reports pipeline went to Boreal as of 2025-06-25, not Ember; Team Ember never owned it, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction]
    earlier: Team Ember owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-06-25, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- The webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys. [decision; valid 2025-09-16 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-09-16]
- The webhook dispatcher moved from Team Atlas to Team Dune on 2026-04-22. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-webhooks]
- On 2026-03-16, Ember noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-16]
- Oskar picked up the Ember on-call shift from Diego on 2026-06-17. [decision; valid 2026-06-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-06-17]
- Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Farah for the job scheduler handover on 2025-04-04. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-scheduler]
- The webhook dispatcher is owned by Team Dune as of 2026-04-22, after Team Atlas kept it until then. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-webhooks]
- On 2026-04-29, Ember noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-04-29 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-04-29]
- The webhooks service has a deploy window on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-21 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-21]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-10 that the authentication gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2025-11-10 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-10]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2025-11-17 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump. [valid 2025-11-17 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-11-17]
- The webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery. [decision; valid 2026-02-11 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Team Ember reported at standup on 2026-05-27 that the notifier's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift. [valid 2026-05-27 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-27]
- Marcus Oyelaran wrote up the handover doc for Tomasz for the event bus handover on 2025-09-09. [valid 2025-09-09 to now; recorded by handover/2025-09-09-event-bus]
- After the cache change, the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week. [valid 2025-03-11 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-11-2]
- Diego has the Ember pager as of the 2026-05-13 cycle, taking over from Oskar. [decision; valid 2026-05-13 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-05-13]
    earlier: Oskar has the Ember pager as of the 2026-03-16 cycle, taking over from Diego. [decision; valid 2026-03-16 to 2026-05-13; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-16]
    earlier: Diego carries the Team Ember on-call phone as of the 2026-01-23 on-call swap, until the next rotation. [decision; valid 2026-01-23 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/ember/2026-01-23]
    earlier: Oskar is on call for team Ember this cycle. [valid 2025-05-28 to 2026-01-23; recorded by standup/ember/2025-05-28]

Question: Which note recorded the handover of webhooks to Ember, and on what date?
